blocks.prompt: 17. If \(\frac{1}{a}, \frac{1}{b}\) and \(\frac{1}{c}\) are in A.P., show that \(b = \frac{2ac}{a + c}\).
blocks.explanation:
Yeh proof hai. Teen numbers A.P. mein hain, to wohi purana qaida: beech wale ka dugna = baqi do ka jama.
Humein \(b\) ko akela (subject) bana kar dikhana hai.
Plan: shart likhna, right side ke fractions jama karna, phir dono taraf ulta (reciprocal) lena.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(\frac{1}{a}, \frac{1}{b}, \frac{1}{c}\) A.P. mein hain (\(a, b, c \ne 0\))
Saabit karna hai: \(b = \frac{2ac}{a + c}\).
Tareeqa: \(2 \times \text{beech wali} = \text{pehli} + \text{aakhri}\). Yahan terms khud fractions hain, lekin qaida wohi hai.

A.P. wali shart likhein
\[\dfrac{2}{b} = \dfrac{1}{a} + \dfrac{1}{c}\]
Kyun: A.P. mein \(\frac{1}{b} - \frac{1}{a} = \frac{1}{c} - \frac{1}{b}\) hota hai (barabar farq). \(\frac{1}{b}\) ko ek taraf jama karein to \(\frac{2}{b}\) ban jata hai.

Fractions jama karein
\[\dfrac{2}{b} = \dfrac{c + a}{ac}\]
Kyun: \(\frac{1}{a}\) aur \(\frac{1}{c}\) ka common denominator \(ac\) hai: \(\frac{c}{ac} + \frac{a}{ac}\).

Dono taraf reciprocal lein
\[\dfrac{b}{2} = \dfrac{ac}{a + c}\]
\[b = \dfrac{2ac}{a + c}\]
Kyun: Do barabar (non-zero) fractions ko ulta karein to bhi woh barabar rehte hain. Phir dono taraf 2 se multiply kiya.
Dhyan dein: \(\frac{1}{a} + \frac{1}{c}\) ko \(\frac{1}{a + c}\) likhna bohat bari ghalti hai; fractions aise jama nahi hote.

Tasdeeq: numbers rakh kar
\(a = 1,\ c = 3\) lein: \(b = \frac{2(3)}{4} = \frac{3}{2}\)
\[\tfrac{1}{1},\ \tfrac{2}{3},\ \tfrac{1}{3}:\ \text{gaps } -\tfrac{1}{3},\ -\tfrac{1}{3} \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Formula wala \(b\) lene se reciprocals ke farq barabar aaye, yani A.P. ban gayi. (Aise \(b\) ko \(a\) aur \(c\) ka harmonic mean kehte hain; aage parhenge.)
